verdict.rationale: Daytona documents arbitrary command execution via the SDK's `sandbox.process.exec()` (docs-33), the browser web terminal (docs-9), and token-based SSH access (docs-32), each inside isolated sandboxes with their own kernel and filesystem (docs-28). Package installation is supported indirectly: snapshots capture installed packages and dependencies (docs-2), and images or Dockerfiles can define packages (docs-21). Community testing reports some SSH terminal glitches with full-screen apps like vim and Emacs (comm-3), but this does not contradict command execution. missing for 10: an explicit documented example of installing packages at runtime (e.g. pip/apt inside a running sandbox), and independent hands-on corroboration of sandbox command execution.
